value.note: Blessed Swiftness: when an ally’s movement inside the aura triggers an enemy’s reaction, that ally gains a +2 status bonus to all defenses against it. (The +5-foot status bonus is yours while on foot; if you’re mounted, your mount gains the bonus instead.)

backfillRows.why: AoN class-feature-877 (Blessing of the Devoted, Player Core 2 pg. 86): "Blessed Swiftness: You gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speed. If you're mounted, your mount gains the bonus instead." The shipped modeAdjust note ended "(The +5-foot Speed is yours wherever you stand and is already on your sheet.)" - it told the player the opposite of the clause the record's own description prints. Whole value re-emitted with only the parenthetical replaced (modeAdjust is one field), superseding the existing overlay row on classFeatures/blessed-swiftness.modeAdjust. landSpeedBonus:5 stays as it is: neither our engine nor WG has a mount-Speed carrier, so the redirect is disclosed in the note rather than silently mis-modelled.

findings.note: Text-only amendment to an existing overlay row (supersedes, whole value merged). No mounted-Speed mechanic is invented - the mount lane does not exist on either side, so the honest fix is to stop contradicting print in the disclosure the player reads.

backfillRows.why: AoN class-feature-877 (Blessing of the Devoted, Player Core 2 pg. 86) carries the section "Blessed Swiftness: You gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speed...". The shipped aonParentId was equipment-2320 - Bracers of Devotion, an Item 11 from Treasure Vault (Remastered), whose same-named section reads only "Blessed Swiftness The bonus to Speed is +10 feet." - a different mechanic from a different book, joined by name collision. The sibling classFeatures/blessed-shield already joins to class-feature-877. No existing overlay row for this field on this record, so no supersedes.

AoN class-feature-877 spells its section headings with a colon ("Blessed Armament:", "Blessed Shield:", "Blessed Swiftness:"), and the sibling classFeatures/blessed-shield carries aonSection "Blessed Shield:" against the same parent. The shipped "Blessed Swiftness" (no colon) was the Bracers of Devotion spelling and would not match under the corrected parent. No existing overlay row for this field on this record, so no supersedes.

findings.note: Two fields, one record, one finding - the parent and the section key must move together or the join lands on a heading that does not exist in the new parent. Both are print-join fields (read by render-check.mjs / lane-sample.mjs / wg-field-catalogue.mjs), not player-visible.
